issue.description:
Place the built binary in a permanent, discoverable location with its metadata attached

Acceptance:
- Copy the binary to a known, versioned location
- Attach or embed the recorded metadata (commit SHA, binary hash)
- Ensure the binary is discoverable and referenceable
- Verify the pinned location is accessible and contains all metadata

Prerequisites: Metadata must be recorded (depends on child 2)
issue.title: Pin binary to known location with metadata
